title: Get to know Reports: New Patients, Inactive Patients and more
summary: Tour of New Patients, Inactive Patients, Treatments in Progress, Schedule Occupancy and Cancellations: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Reports
steps.details: We'll go through New Patients, Inactive Patients, Treatments in Progress, Schedule Occupancy and Cancellations.

steps.title: New Patients
steps.details: Patients registered in the period and whether they've already had their first appointment. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Inactive Patients
steps.details: Patients who haven't come in a while, for win-back campaigns. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Treatments in Progress
steps.details: Multi-stage treatments that haven't finished yet, to follow up on them. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Schedule Occupancy
steps.details: Appointment analysis: how many were completed, canceled or no-shows, and how many ended in a quote or session. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Cancellations
steps.details: Appointments canceled or no-shows in the period, with reason, doctor and patient. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».
